text: Last week, while taxiing to the runway, we got a hydraulic low-quantity warning. After confirming that we were losing fluid, we stopped and called for a tug. Unfortunately, we had to wait for nearly an hour before it came. By the time we finally changed planes and took off, we were two hours late. How did they get back to the gate?
